amendment.titleSw: Upatanishi wa Menyu ya Juu & Uteuzi wa Wajibu wa Akaunti
amendment.titleEn: Top App Bar Layout & Account Role Routing Amendment
amendment.descriptionSw: Vitufe vyote vya menyu sasa vinakaa kwenye safu moja bila kufichika kwenye simu ndogo na kubwa. Wanunuzi na Wauzaji sasa wanachagua wajibu wao wanapojiunga na kuelekezwa kwenye miingiliano yao husika.
amendment.descriptionEn: All app bar icons now fit seamlessly on the same row across all mobile viewports. Role declaration upon sign-up routes buyers and sellers to their tailored interface display.
highlightsSw: Vitufe vyote vya App Bar vinakaa kwenye safu moja kwenye simu na kompyuta
Uteuzi wa Mnunuzi (Buyer) au Muuzaji (Seller) wakati wa kujiandikisha/kuingia
Kurasa za bidhaa na wateja zimewekewa mipaka ili maandishi yasipitishe ukingo wa ukurasa
Uwezo wa kupata taarifa za maboresho ya hivi karibuni na kupakia upya kivinjari
highlightsEn: All app bar icons fit on one row across all mobile and desktop screens
Role declaration for Buyers and Sellers with direct interface routing
Text boundary containment on seller management and inquiries
Live feature amendment notification with one-click browser refresh

amendmentHistory.titleSw: Upatanishi wa Menyu ya Juu & Uteuzi wa Wajibu wa Akaunti
amendmentHistory.titleEn: Top App Bar Layout & Account Role Routing Amendment
amendmentHistory.descriptionSw: Vitufe vyote vya menyu ya juu vinakaa kwenye ukurasa mmoja bila kufichika. Uteuzi wa mnunuzi/muuzaji unafanya kazi papo hapo.
amendmentHistory.descriptionEn: Top app bar icons all visible and fitted on same row. Direct buyer/seller declared interfaces.

amendmentHistory.titleSw: Maboresho ya Ufungashaji wa Maandishi kwenye Dashibodi ya Wauzaji
amendmentHistory.descriptionSw: Kurekebisha mpangilio ili maelezo na jumbe zisipite pembezoni mwa ukurasa.
amendmentHistory.descriptionEn: Fixed text boundaries in seller inventory and incoming buyer inquiries.

amendmentHistory.titleSw: Usaidizi wa Arifa za Simu (FCM) & Sera ya Bidhaa Haramu
amendmentHistory.descriptionSw: Ujumuishaji wa taarifa za papo hapo na udhibiti wa bidhaa zilizopigwa marufuku.
amendmentHistory.descriptionEn: Real-time push alerts and automated prohibited keyword moderation.
